mapper.select: SELECT account_no AS accountNo, owner_name AS ownerName, wallet_type AS walletType, status, FORMAT(available_amount, 2) AS availableAmount, FORMAT(frozen_amount, 2) AS frozenAmount, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_wallet_account ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT account_no AS accountNo, owner_name AS ownerName, wallet_type AS walletType, status, FORMAT(available_amount, 2) AS availableAmount, FORMAT(frozen_amount, 2) AS frozenAmount, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_wallet_account WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}

SELECT ledger_no AS ledgerNo, account_no AS accountNo, biz_type AS bizType, biz_no AS bizNo, FORMAT(amount, 2) AS amount, direction, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_wallet_ledger WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC
